tasks.short: Summarize technical findings for physician interpretation

steps.what: Review technical data and capture findings with source locations
Summarize selected findings in a technical draft

loop.input: Technologist-selected findings with recording references and uncertainty
loop.output: Draft preserving findings, qualifications and source references
loop.check: Technologist compares every statement with selected findings and recording, including omitted abnormalities and negation
loop.stop: One draft; unsupported claims or inadequate source notes return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text observations vary; test a fixed template first and use a loop only for narrative drafting

steps.what: Check summary fidelity and retain the final technical version

tasks.design: Keep recording review in the clinical recording system {OTHER}. A bounded draft in {DOCS} uses only selected observations; the technologist checks its meaning and finalises the summary before the separate physician-submission task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative findings need careful wording and recording context.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-bound drafting can reduce typing without delegating signal interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Artifacts, clinical context and uncertainty can change the meaning of a finding.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist distinguishes technical limitations from findings requiring physician attention.
tasks.altitude: Less narrative typing; recording assessment and diagnostic authority do not change.

reach.task: Check source traceability in technical reports

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts consultation summaries into a clinical record; this supports drafting capability, not validation for neurodiagnostic summaries.
The proposed technical-summary adaptation and time estimates are model knowledge and require local validation.

assumptions: Boundary is technical summarisation after acquisition; physician diagnosis and report submission are outside this task.

In s1 the technologist produces patient and test identifiers, recording version, observation text, source interval, technical limitation and uncertainty. Capture and interpretation retain all 40 hours; missing references mean manual drafting.
Test native clinical templates before custom drafting. The model never interprets raw signals or supplies absent findings.
Allow five additional focal hours for template correction and error review.
unknowns: Approved clinical software and document interfaces
research_questions: Does drafting preserve every qualification and reduce net technologist time on representative recordings?

already_counted.description: Source selection and final fidelity checking

approvals.approved_version: Exact final technical summary, patient/test identity and source recording version; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 scenario B100 R82.5 gives gross17.5 minus5 upkeep =12.5 net. High assumes adequate selected notes; low allows drafting retries to consume the gain. Recording review remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Submit final test reports to physicians

steps.what: Check report identity, final version and physician recipient
Transfer the selected report into the physician delivery workspace
Verify staged contents and submit reports to physicians

tasks.design: Configure the clinical record system {OTHER} to stage an exact copy of the final report against the verified routing instruction. The technologist checks recipient and contents and submits it; no new summary or diagnosis is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Separate report and delivery screens can require manual copying.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document routing may reuse the final report without re-entry.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong-patient selection, corrected reports and urgent findings require human attention.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist checks that the right physician receives the right technical result.
tasks.altitude: Less document transfer; responsibility for release is unchanged.

evidence.claim: Native staging of an exact report and gated delivery is an E1 design from model knowledge; no digest case establishes its savings.

assumptions: Boundary starts with an already-final technical report, produced in the separate summary task. Its creation is not counted or saved again here.

In s1 the technologist captures patient ID, test ID, report version, recipient identifier and destination from the order and checks authority to disclose. All 35 hours remain; missing or ambiguous fields cause manual routing.
Test native report delivery first. Claim copying savings only where manual transfer exists today; existing automatic runtime earns none.
Allow five focal hours for directory corrections and failed-delivery handling beyond s3.
research_questions: Can native routing stage the exact report and expose recipient and receipt before release?

approvals.approved_version: Exact staged report version, patient/test IDs and physician destination; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R60 gross40 minus5 upkeep =35 net in a manual-transfer scenario. Low assumes routing already exists; no clinical interpretation savings.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Train clinical colleagues in neurodiagnostic practice

steps.what: Assist in training technicians through demonstrations and supervised practice

tasks.design: Retain practical training and immediate supervision. Existing guidance in {DOCS} can support demonstrations without replacing observation of technique or patient response.
tasks.previous_blocker: Practical competence is demonstrated through supervised action.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change removes this task's instructional work.
tasks.still_hard: Trainees can appear confident while making subtle acquisition errors.
tasks.human_edge: The instructor adapts feedback and intervenes before unsafe practice continues.
tasks.altitude: No change to training responsibility or time is claimed.

reach.task: Explain preparation for shared neurodiagnostic procedures
reach.learn: Nursing handoff and patient preparation boundaries

evidence.claim: Supervised technical instruction remains human work; this is model knowledge rather than a measured case.

assumptions: Boundary is practical instruction and feedback; course administration is outside it.
No machine step or structured-input contract is introduced.
No custom software is proposed; existing guidance stays in use.
Zero incremental upkeep because the work and tools are unchanged.
research_questions: Which observed errors require immediate instructor intervention?

incremental.description: No changed process or tool upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Practical instruction remains fully counted; no speculative preparation baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in research and professional technical meetings

steps.what: Participate in research projects, conferences and technical discussions

tasks.design: Retain direct research participation and technical discussion. Existing materials in {DOCS} remain references; this broad task does not establish a separate clerical activity that can safely be removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Research contributions depend on the actual protocol and discussion.
tasks.enabler_now: Drafting tools do not replace attendance, observation or scientific challenge.
tasks.still_hard: Judging technical relevance and responding to unexpected findings.
tasks.human_edge: The technologist contributes practical acquisition experience and challenges interpretations.
tasks.altitude: No decision rights or weekly time change is claimed.

reach.task: Identify acquisition constraints in a proposed study

evidence.claim: Maintaining human scientific participation is an E1 assessment from model knowledge, not a measured productivity claim.

assumptions: Boundary is participation itself; study administration and report writing need separate task evidence.
No structured-input producer or machine action is introduced.
No custom tool is needed; retain existing meeting and document facilities.
Zero incremental upkeep because no process changes.
research_questions: Does a specific study contain a separate repeatable administrative task worth assessing?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Research and meeting participation remain fully human; no invented documentation share.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Spend less time transferring and wording reports where local systems permit; preserve recording review, release checks and teaching.
reach: Support medical records staff with report provenance
Help research coordinators assess acquisition constraints
role.ambitious_version: A technologist who produces traceable technical findings and protects time for safe acquisition and colleague learning.
